title: BestConfigProtectedPublish401
description: The 401 body of a PROTECTED POST /api/v1/best-configs (the content-less identity layer is enabled and the request carries X-Traigent-Agent-Ref; these two conditions alone select the envelope, before any session is resolved; with the layer disabled every response is the legacy one, whatever the headers): the closed refusal envelope (best_config_head_refusal_schema.json) restricted to `unauthenticated` (fixed text), whatever the authentication layer would otherwise have said. A malformed protected body matches nothing. The execution endpoint combines this with the unchanged legacy 401 body in two DISJOINT branches (the legacy branch must not carry `unauthenticated`).
